Machine-learning models redistributed with this application

Both files below run entirely in the visitor's browser during identity
verification. Neither the document photo, the selfie, nor the extracted text
is sent to the model's original host — the files are served from this origin
precisely so that no third party learns who started a verification, and so the
Content-Security-Policy does not have to name an outside connect-src host.
See frontend/src/lib/identity-verification/ocr.js and face.js.

Neither file is committed: 6.4 MB of unreviewable binary in every clone, for
bytes that never change. `frontend/scripts/fetch-models.mjs` downloads them
from the URLs below, checks each against the sha256 recorded here, and only
then writes it. `prebuild` and `predev` run it, so `npm run build` and
`npm run dev` — and therefore CI, the deploy job and Playwright — provision
them with no manual step. A verified copy is cached in node_modules/.cache/
models, so a repeat build is a hash check rather than a download.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/tessdata/eng.traineddata.gz

  Tesseract OCR English language data ("tessdata_best", 4.0.0 int).
  Copyright Google Inc. and the Tesseract contributors.
  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 — see Apache-2.0.txt.

  Obtained from:
    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tesseract.js-data/eng/4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz
  Upstream project:
    https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best
  sha256: 45b4cb346724ac1774f1c36f42f182b887bcdb28ebe63e6fff90ac41f3fcff91

  Unmodified. Read by tesseract.js via its langPath option and cached by the
  worker in IndexedDB after the first load.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/models/face_landmarker.task

  MediaPipe Face Landmarker, float16 revision 1.
  Copyright The MediaPipe Authors.
  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 — see Apache-2.0.txt.

  Obtained from:
    https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task
  Upstream project:
    https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
  sha256: 64184e229b263107bc2b804c6625db1341ff2bb731874b0bcc2fe6544e0bc9ff

  Unmodified. Pinned to revision 1 rather than tracking "latest", so the model
  deciding whether a selfie shows a live face cannot change without a commit.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To replace either model, drop a compatible file at the same path and rebuild;
nothing in the application verifies their contents. Re-run the checksums above
after any deliberate update so a silent swap remains detectable.
